categories.main_business_segments: Mingyue Optical Lens Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the optical lens industry, focusing on the research, design, production, and sales of optical resin lenses, lens raw materials, finished lenses, and frames. The company’s core products include mid-to-high-end optical resin lenses under the 'Mingyue' brand, with a comprehensive product line covering daily use lenses and functional lenses such as myopia control, anti-blue light, high refractive index, and progressive multifocal lenses. It also engages in the production and supply of lens raw materials, collaborating with global partners to establish a leading raw material R&D and production center.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes advanced optical design, proprietary resin materials, and innovative manufacturing processes including 3D internal engraving technology for myopia control lenses. It has developed high refractive index lenses with high Abbe numbers, breaking industry technical barriers. The company also integrates intelligent manufacturing systems (SAP, MES, WMS) to ensure rapid and high-quality delivery, achieving 99%+ on-time delivery rates. Continuous R&D efforts focus on optical materials, coating technologies, and lens customization to meet diverse visual needs.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Mingyue serves a broad customer base including optical retail chains, eye hospitals, and end consumers across China. Its products cater to various demographics, notably children and adolescents for myopia control, as well as middle-aged and elderly populations requiring multifocal and high-index lenses. The company also targets medical channels and collaborates with ophthalmic institutions to promote clinical applications of its products. Its market includes both domestic retail and specialized medical sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company’s operations are primarily concentrated in China, with extensive sales networks covering all provinces and cities. It also has subsidiaries and business activities in Shanghai, Jiangsu, Zhejiang, and overseas presence through subsidiaries in Singapore and Hong Kong. The company is expanding into high-end markets including Hong Kong and Macau, and actively participates in international exhibitions and collaborations.
categories.supply_chain_position: Mingyue operates across the midstream and upstream segments of the optical lens supply chain. It manufactures optical lenses and lens raw materials, including resin monomers and adhesives, achieving significant self-sufficiency in raw materials. The company also provides finished lenses and frames, integrating R&D, production, and sales, positioning itself as a vertically integrated player in the optical lens industry.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on technological innovation, brand building, and expanding market leadership in China’s optical lens industry. R&D priorities include developing advanced optical materials, functional coatings, and customized myopia control lenses with proven clinical efficacy. It actively pursues collaborations with academic institutions and industry experts, invests in digital transformation, and explores emerging technologies such as AI smart glasses. The company aims to lead the industry through a 'technology + brand + capital + ecosystem' strategy.
categories.revenue_model: Mingyue generates revenue primarily through the sale of optical lenses, raw materials, finished lenses, and frames. Its sales channels include direct sales to optical retail stores and eye hospitals, distribution through dealers, and e-commerce platforms. The company also earns income from investment returns and government subsidies related to R&D and innovation projects.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Mingyue is the leading domestic optical lens brand in China, holding the largest market share by retail volume (12.4%) and recognized as the top-selling lens brand for nine consecutive years. It differentiates itself through proprietary technology, product quality, and brand strength. The company competes against both domestic and international lens manufacturers but maintains a dominant position in the mid-to-high-end market segments and myopia control lenses.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Mingyue reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 770.3 million, a 2.88% increase over the previous year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 176.8 million, up 12.21%. The company’s total assets reached RMB 1.86 billion, growing 6.18% year-over-year. It maintains strong cash flow generation and continues to invest significantly in R&D, with expenditures increasing by nearly 25%. The company’s financials reflect steady growth and resilience amid market challenges.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Mingyue emphasizes high-quality, technologically advanced optical lenses tailored to Chinese consumers’ visual needs, including innovative myopia control solutions with clinically validated efficacy. Its products combine superior optical performance, durability, and comfort, such as high refractive index lenses with high Abbe numbers and anti-blue light coatings with minimal color distortion. The company’s brand is strongly associated with trust, innovation, and social responsibility, reinforced by partnerships with national aerospace projects and leading academic institutions, delivering comprehensive visual health solutions.
